mapPin.title: A Small Act of Kindness
mapPin.content:
Scene 1: A friend in the park
Setting: A sunny park with a bench and a shady tree.
[Stage directions: Pip sits beside the bench. Fox walks over and listens.]
Fox: You look worried, Pip. Can I help you?
Pip: I lost my letter. Thank you for helping me.
[They look for the letter together and find it under the bench.]
Pip (thinking): I feel less worried because my friend cares.

Scene 2: Scene 2
Setting: The same sunny park at sunset, with the letter safe in Pip’s bag.
Pip: I will deliver the letter now. We found it together!
Fox: I am happy to help a friend. See you tomorrow!
